note: Both sets correctly capture the design-point power coefficient CP = 0.489 for the 15-MW rotor (with the redundant dimensionless-unit variant appearing in both). Set B additionally extracts the wind-speed axis range of 3 to 25 m/s across Regions 1.5, 2 and 3, which is supported by the plotted axis ticks and region bands in subplots (a)-(c). Neither set invents values or misbinds properties, so B's extra supported claim gives it the edge, though the duplicated CP claim is trivial in both.
